form.label: ViewDNS Investigate
form.description: Look up a domain, IP address, email address or MAC address with ViewDNS.info. Click a domain, IP or email in a table to pivot to it.

input.label: Domain, IP, email or MAC address

html.p: Each new value uses ViewDNS API queries: a domain 8 (WHOIS, IP history, DNS records, subdomains, reverse IP, abuse contact, DNSSEC, free email), an IP 6 (WHOIS, reverse IP, location, reverse DNS, abuse contact, spam blacklists), an email 2, a MAC address 1. Live checks add 3 and make ViewDNS servers contact the target. Results are cached (default 24 hours; live checks and blacklists 1 hour), so repeat lookups are free. Requires the viewdns_user role or the viewdns_lookup capability.

search.query: | makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=whois field=q | fields viewdns_* | fields - viewdns_action viewdns_query viewdns_cached viewdns_result_count viewdns_total_count viewdns_truncated | transpose 0 column_name=Field | rename "row 1" as Value | eval Field=replace(Field, "^viewdns_", "") | where isnotnull(Value) AND Value!=""

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=abuselookup field=q prefix=a_ | viewdns action=dnssec field=q prefix=s_ | viewdns action=freeemail field=q prefix=f_ | eval "Abuse contact"=coalesce(a_abuse_contact, a_error, "none found"), DNSSEC=case(s_dnssec_enabled="true", "Enabled (algorithm ".mvjoin(mvdedup(s_dnssec_algorithm), ", ").")", s_dnssec_enabled="false", "Not enabled", true(), coalesce(s_error, "unknown")), "Free email provider"=case(f_free_email="true", "Yes", f_free_email="false", "No", true(), coalesce(f_error, "unknown")) | table "Abuse contact" DNSSEC "Free email provider"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=iphistory field=q output=rows limit=$limit$ | where isnotnull(viewdns_ip) | table viewdns_ip viewdns_owner viewdns_location viewdns_last_seen | rename viewdns_ip as "IP address", viewdns_owner as Owner, viewdns_location as Location, viewdns_last_seen as "Last seen"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=dnsrecord field=q recordtype=ANY output=rows limit=$limit$ | where isnotnull(viewdns_record_type) | table viewdns_record_type viewdns_record_name viewdns_record_priority viewdns_record_data viewdns_record_ttl | rename viewdns_record_type as Type, viewdns_record_name as Name, viewdns_record_priority as Priority, viewdns_record_data as Data, viewdns_record_ttl as TTL

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=subdomains field=q output=rows limit=$limit$ | eval Shown=viewdns_result_count." of ".viewdns_total_count | where isnotnull(viewdns_subdomain) | table viewdns_subdomain viewdns_subdomain_ips viewdns_last_resolved Shown | rename viewdns_subdomain as Subdomain, viewdns_subdomain_ips as "IP addresses", viewdns_last_resolved as "Last resolved"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=iplocation field=q prefix=l_ | viewdns action=reversedns field=q prefix=r_ | viewdns action=abuselookup field=q prefix=a_ | eval Location=coalesce(mvjoin(mvappend(l_city, l_region_name, l_country_name), ", "), l_error, "unknown"), Coordinates=if(isnotnull(l_latitude), l_latitude.", ".l_longitude, null()), "Reverse DNS"=coalesce(r_rdns, r_error, "none"), "Abuse contact"=coalesce(a_abuse_contact, a_error, "none found") | table Location Coordinates "Reverse DNS" "Abuse contact"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=spamdblookup field=q output=rows limit=100 | where isnotnull(viewdns_blacklist) | eval Listed=if(viewdns_blacklist_result="ok", "no", "LISTED"), sort_key=if(Listed="LISTED", 0, 1) | eventstats count as total, sum(eval(if(Listed="LISTED",1,0))) as listed | eval Summary="Listed on ".listed." of ".total | sort sort_key viewdns_blacklist | table viewdns_blacklist Listed viewdns_blacklist_result Summary | rename viewdns_blacklist as Blacklist, viewdns_blacklist_result as Result

panel.title: Reverse IP: other domains on the same server

search.query: | makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=reverseip field=q output=rows limit=$limit$ | eval Shown=viewdns_result_count." of ".viewdns_total_count | where isnotnull(viewdns_domain) | table viewdns_domain viewdns_last_resolved Shown | rename viewdns_domain as Domain, viewdns_last_resolved as "Last resolved"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=portscan field=q output=rows limit=100 | where isnotnull(viewdns_port) | eval sort_key=if(viewdns_port_status="open", 0, 1), port_num=tonumber(viewdns_port) | sort sort_key port_num | table viewdns_port viewdns_service viewdns_port_status viewdns_cached | rename viewdns_port as Port, viewdns_service as Service, viewdns_port_status as Status, viewdns_cached as Cached

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=httpheaders field=q output=rows limit=100 | where isnotnull(viewdns_header_name) | table viewdns_header_name viewdns_header_value | rename viewdns_header_name as Header, viewdns_header_value as Value

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=traceroute field=q output=rows limit=100 | where isnotnull(viewdns_hop) | table viewdns_hop viewdns_hop_hostname viewdns_hop_ip viewdns_hop_rtt | rename viewdns_hop as Hop, viewdns_hop_hostname as Hostname, viewdns_hop_ip as "IP address", viewdns_hop_rtt as "RTT (ms)"

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=freeemail field=q | eval Domain=viewdns_query, "Free email provider"=case(viewdns_free_email="true", "Yes", viewdns_free_email="false", "No", true(), coalesce(viewdns_error, "unknown")) | table Domain "Free email provider"

panel.title: Reverse WHOIS: domains registered with this email

search.query: | makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=reversewhois field=q output=rows limit=$limit$ | eval Shown=viewdns_result_count." of ".viewdns_total_count | where isnotnull(viewdns_domain) | table viewdns_domain viewdns_created viewdns_registrar Shown | rename viewdns_domain as Domain, viewdns_created as Created, viewdns_registrar as Registrar

| makeresults | eval q=$q|s$ | viewdns action=maclookup field=q | eval Manufacturer=case(viewdns_status="ok", viewdns_manufacturer, viewdns_status="no_results", "Not found in the OUI database", true(), viewdns_error) | table Manufacturer

panel.title: Enrichment events for this value (ViewDNS Enrichment alert action, last 30 days)

search.query: index=* sourcetype="viewdns:enrichment" query=$q|s$ | table _time search_name lookup status result_count total_count orig_sid | sort - _time
